title: Classified Employees Reduction In Force - Lack of Funds and/or Lack of Work - 2022-2023 Fiscal Year - Talent/Human Resources Department
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0122 - Classified Employees Reduction In Force Due to Lack of Funds and/or Lack of Work 2022-2023 Fiscal Year.
headline: Adopts a plan to lay off classified staff for 2022-23 if funds or work run short
summary: The Board is adopting a resolution that allows the district to reduce classified (non-teaching) staff for the 2022-23 fiscal year because of a lack of funds or a lack of work. The text does not say how many positions are affected or name specific jobs.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–2), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

title: Temporary Hiring Freeze – School Sites and Central Office Positions – Talent/Human Resources Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0123 - Temporary Hiring Freeze - School Sites and Central Office Positions [Effective January 27, 2022].
headline: Freezes hiring for school site and central office positions starting January 27, 2022
summary: The Board is approving a temporary hiring freeze that covers positions at school sites and in the central office. The freeze takes effect January 27, 2022. The text does not say when it ends.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Emma Donnelly - East Oakland Pride Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Emma Donnelly, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide English as Second Language (ESL) classes to 25-30 parents, twice per week for 16 weeks at East Oakland Pride Elementary School, for the period of January 24, 2022, through March 25, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $2,500.00.
headline: Ratifies up to $2,500 for English classes for parents at East Oakland Pride Elementary
summary: The Board is ratifying (approving after the fact) a services agreement with an Oakland contractor to teach English as a Second Language (ESL) classes to 25-30 parents, twice a week for 16 weeks, at East Oakland Pride Elementary School. The agreement runs January 24 to March 25, 2022, and began before the Board's vote. Payment is capped at $2,500, from Title I grant funds.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2021-2022 - Spearitwurx - Office of Equity
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2021-2022 by and between the District and Spearitwurx, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide Equity and Wellness Engagement pre and post-assessment for teachers and staff (plus… review available data for students and families); site visit and consultation with designated … Consultant and school site administrative team, lead teachers and/or staff to determine school-specific equity needs; facilitation of 5-7 customized professional engagement sessions - (can be done in no less than 90- minute blocks - total of 15 hours of direct facilitation) and customized Equity and Wellness kits for participating staff 1-on-1 and group-coaching sessions for selected staff (as needed), via the Office of Equity, for the period of January 3, 2022 through June 30, 2022, in an amount not to exceed $97,500.00.
headline: Pays Spearitwurx up to $97,500 for equity and wellness sessions for school staff
summary: The Board is approving a services agreement with Spearitwurx for equity and wellness work through the Office of Equity: a staff assessment, school site visits, 5-7 customized sessions (15 hours of facilitation), wellness kits, and coaching for selected staff. The agreement runs January 3 to June 30, 2022, so it began before the Board's vote. Payment is capped at $97,500.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Student Travel - College and University Campuses Tour - Eugene, Oregon - Castlemont High School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0156 - Authorization for Approval of Student Travel by school site Castlemont High School, for 12 students and 3 adults, as specified in Out of State Field Trip/Excursion Request, attached, to volunteer with Habitat for Humanity, and to travel and tour the college campuses of Bushnell University, Lane Community College, and the University of Oregon, Eugene, Oregon, for the period of January 31, 2022 through February 4, 2022, at no cost to the District.
headline: Approves Castlemont High trip to tour Oregon colleges and volunteer, at no cost to the district
summary: The Board is approving an out-of-state trip for 12 Castlemont High School students and 3 adults to Eugene, Oregon, from January 31 to February 4, 2022. The group will volunteer with Habitat for Humanity and tour Bushnell University, Lane Community College and the University of Oregon. The trip costs the district nothing.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: District "Brown Act" Legislative Bodies - February 2022 - Virtual Meetings - Board of Education
official_text: Adoption by the Board of Education of Resolution No. 2122-0014D - Making Certain Findings Necessary To Permit Virtual Meetings In Specified Circumstances for February 2022.
headline: Allows district boards to meet virtually in February 2022 under the Brown Act
summary: The Board is adopting a resolution making the findings needed to let district public bodies hold virtual meetings in February 2022. The Brown Act is California's open-meeting law for public bodies.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (4–3), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

title: In-Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement for 2022-2024 - Ascend Charter School - Office of Charter Schools
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of the In Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement by and between the District and Ascend Charter School, for use of the Ascend Campus, for a two-year term, July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2024, as specified in the Agreement:
·	for 44,704 square feet: 2022-23 Proposition 39 per square foot rate during the 2022-23 Fiscal Year*; and 1.05 times the 2023-24 Proposition 39 per square foot rate during the 2023-24 Fiscal Year.
____
*Anticipated revenue to the District of $216,367.00 in 2022-23.
headline: Leases the Ascend Campus to Ascend Charter School for two years, about $216,367 in 2022-23
summary: The Board is approving a two-year facilities use agreement, July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2024, letting Ascend Charter School use the 44,704-square-foot Ascend Campus. The charter school pays a Proposition 39 per-square-foot rate in 2022-23 and 1.05 times that year's rate in 2023-24. The district expects about $216,367 in revenue in 2022-23.
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–2), instead of with the rest of the consent report.

title: In-Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement for 2022-2023, With Option for 2023-2024 - Community School for Creative Education - Office of Charter Schools
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of the In Lieu of Proposition 39 Facilities Use Agreement by and between the District and Community School for Creative Education, a Charter School, for use of 2111 International Blvd, for a one-year term, July 1, 2022 through June 30, 2023, with an option to extend for an additional year through June 30, 2024, as specified in the Agreement:
·	for 17,870 square feet: 2022-23 Proposition 39 per square foot rate during the 2022-23 Fiscal Year;* and 1.05 times the 2023-24 Proposition 39 per square foot rate during the 2023-24 Fiscal Year (if elected); and
·	for 3,994 square feet: two (2) times the 2022-23 Proposition 39 per square foot rate during the 2022-23 Fiscal Year; and two (2) times the 2023-24 Proposition 39 per square foot rate during the 2023-24 Fiscal Year (if elected).
_____
*Anticipated revenue to the District of $126,351.00 in 2022-23 (if elected).
headline: Leases 2111 International Blvd to Community School for Creative Education, about $126,351 in 2022-23
summary: The Board is approving a one-year facilities use agreement, July 1, 2022 to June 30, 2023, with an option to extend through June 30, 2024, for the charter school to use 2111 International Blvd. Rent is set by Proposition 39 per-square-foot rates: 17,870 square feet at the base rate and 3,994 square feet at two times the rate. The district expects about $126,351 in revenue in 2022-23 (if elected).
pulled_from_consent: Adopted in its own vote at this meeting (5–2), instead of with the rest of the consent report.
